# semgrep 1.181.0 (and the latest, 1.182.1) pins mcp==1.29.0. mcp >= 1.8.0, < 1.30.0 lets
# StreamableHTTP sessions accumulate without bound (GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv, Dependabot alerts
# 35/37, fixed in 1.30.0). semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps, so this override lifts mcp
# past semgrep's pin. Drop this file once semgrep's own pins allow mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2

# semgrep 1.181.0 (and 1.182.1) pins the opentelemetry 1.37.0 / 0.58b0 family.
# opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.0 has unbounded tracestate parsing (GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h,
# Dependabot alerts 39/40, fixed in 1.45.1). These overrides lift the whole family
# together (api/sdk/exporter at 1.45.x pull the matching 0.66b instrumentation packages).
# Drop them once semgrep's own pins allow opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading
